## Summary

Describe the change and why it is needed.

## Type of change

- [ ] Bug fix
- [ ] Catalog correction
- [ ] New feature
- [ ] Documentation
- [ ] Security
- [ ] Localization

## Checklist

- [ ] `npm run check` passes.
- [ ] Tests were added or updated when behavior changed.
- [ ] Package IDs were verified with `winget show` when the catalog changed.
- [ ] No analytics, tracking, advertising, or fake forms were added.
- [ ] Privacy or security documentation was updated if behavior changed.
- [ ] The change keeps the existing OpenWin visual design.

## Notes

Add screenshots or other context if useful. Do not include passwords, keys, or personal data.
